job.job_title: Hiring: Generative AI Engineer LLM & RAG | Altimetrik
job.job_description:
Hi,

Greetings from Altimetrik!

We are hiring Generative AI Engineers with strong hands-on experience in LLMs (Large Language Models) and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to join our team at Altimetrik.

Position Details:

Role: Generative AI Engineer
Experience: 69 Years
Mandatory Skills: GenAI, LLM, RAG, Python

Key Skills Required:

Hands-on experience developing Generative AI applications using LLMs.
Strong understanding of RAG architecture, prompt engineering, and embeddings.
Experience with vector databases and semantic search.
Knowledge of Python and API integration.
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex is preferred.

About Altimetrik:

Altimetrik is an AI-first digital engineering company that helps enterprises accelerate digital transformation through AI, data, cloud, and digital engineering solutions.
